end.summary:
Named cube, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Used examples including a rocket, dice, ball, roller and bowl.
Made 3 unaided correct responses across 7 attempts.
Shape names changing when turned or lying down remained a mix-up; it was not corrected in the last seen response.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere using familiar toys and objects. Aditya explained parts of a rocket, identified a dice as a cube, and used balls and marbles for sphere; describing the two circular ends helped with cylinder. The mix-up was that a cone or another shape might get a new name when turned or lying down, and this was still present at the end. At home, show one object at different angles and ask Aditya to name it each time, explaining that its shape name stays the same.
